about_the_game:
Story

Once, there was an honorable samurai in the service of the Shogun, but by night, he transformed into an artist painting forbidden desires with his brush. When a shunga artwork depicting the Shogun’s sister leaked beyond the palace walls, a great scandal erupted. Stripped of his rank and expelled from the Shogun’s service, he became a ronin. The Shogun remained silent… but Kuroda Nobumasa, the powerful daimyo of the Ashina region, would not forgive this disgrace. Swearing vengeance in the name of honor, Nobumasa sent shinobi assassins after him.

Game Features

Step into feudal Japan and forge your own path. In a world adorned with breathtaking East Asian landscapes and intricate atmospheres, mystery awaits at every turn. This game offers a bold and liberated experience filled with adult content, allowing you to explore your passions and push your boundaries. Customize your character, embark on adventures, gather resources, craft, hunt, and fight.

OPEN-WORLD ADULT RPG

In a vast, painterly world, a multitude of characters await to meet and interact with you. Geishas, samurai, blacksmiths, fishermen—each NPC has a unique personality and mystique. Meet, converse, persuade, and seduce. Make the right dialogue choices to convince characters for intimate encounters.

CREATE YOUR CHARACTER

Craft your own samurai with the character creator. Your choices shape the story and dialogues. Build your reputation through your sword or other deeds. Enjoy a freeform gameplay experience. Use the character creator to design your own female NPCs, name them, and host them in your decorated home. Control animations with various positions and find pleasure in intimate scenes.

  • Real-time gameplay. (This is not a text or image-based game; it’s an open-world game with AA graphics.)

  • Feudal Japan world design. (Painterly villages, markets, forests, hot springs, bridges, mountains, and feudal castles.)

  • Rich character creation screen. Over 200 parameters to create and customize your samurai.

  • Adult-oriented scenes.

  • Rich mechanics. (Mining, breaking, gathering, logging, crafting, hunting, and combat.)

  • Decoration and NPC creation screen. Decorate your home, create sexy characters, and experience adult scenes with them.

  • Fluid storytelling with numerous quests and cinematics.

  • Interactable characters. (Each character has a unique dialogue tree, with dialogues that change based on your choices.)

  • Optional customizable organ sizes.
